hook: Murder charges arrived nearly forty years after a Baltimore park killing.

sections.voiceover: Murder charges arrived nearly forty years after a Baltimore park killing.
b_roll: Archival photograph of Druid Hill Park in the 1980s
Close-up of historical police report documents

sections.voiceover: In October 1986, 23-year-old Teresa Ann Houck died inside Druid Hill Park. State prosecutors announced murder and rape indictments for the crime. Where was the suspect hiding?
b_roll: Map view of Druid Hill Park in Baltimore
Portrait photograph of victim Teresa Ann Houck

sections.voiceover: Except 67-year-old David Alexander Williams was already an incarcerated man in Maryland.
b_roll: Exterior shot of a Maryland correctional facility

sections.voiceover: Baltimore City State's Attorney Ivan J. Bates connected the inmate. Handgun charges followed the 1986 murder indictment.
b_roll: Press conference podium of Baltimore State's Attorney Ivan J. Bates
Forensic evidence files on a desk

sections.voiceover: Sixty-seven-year-old David Alexander Williams faces trial for the 1986 murder.
b_roll: Archival newspaper clipping of the 1986 investigation
